recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一條橫貫畫面的管狀結構，由一排細長梭形、首尾相接的內皮細胞核（endothelial nuclei）和淡藍色基質組成，周圍是被抹破的裸核細胞與紅血球，這是骨髓中的小血管。
features: Linear tubular structure composed of elongated spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei aligned end to end
Pale blue-grey fibrillar stromal/basement membrane material along the vessel
Adjacent smudged, bare hematopoietic nuclei with fine reticular chromatin (crush/smear artifact)
Scattered intact small lymphocytes, a neutrophil and red cells nearby
No atypical cohesive tumor cells within or around the vessel
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a capillary-sized vessel traversing the field, composed of a row of elongated, spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei with pale blue fibrillar stroma. Numerous adjacent disrupted bare nuclei with smudged chromatin represent smearing artifact of hematopoietic cells, admixed with intact lymphocytes, a neutrophil and red cells. No cohesive atypical cells are present. Findings represent a normal marrow vascular/stromal element and should not be mistaken for a spindle-cell neoplasm or metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters of large pleomorphic cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding, not a single-file row of bland elongated endothelial nuclei.
Spindled mast cells contain abundant metachromatic purple granules, whereas these endothelial cells have agranular pale cytoplasm.
Fibroblastic fragments are haphazardly arranged with wavy nuclei and collagen rather than forming an organized tubular vessel wall.
